title: Friends
description: Who is playing, and what. Everyone declares it from Nexus App or the site.

empty.title: No friends yet
empty.description: Share your code or enter a friend's: you will be added to each other.

nobodyPlaying: No friend is playing right now.

code.title: My friend code
code.usage: Single use: it disappears as soon as a friend uses it. A new code is created the next time you ask.
code.hint: Generate a code and share it. It works only once.

add.title: Add a friend
add.hint: Enter the code a friend gave you. You will be added to each other.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: You will disappear from their list too. To be friends again, you will need a new code.
remove.body: You will no longer see when {name} is playing.
